contea di ritrovamento: Staffordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C ; D/ CONSTANTINOPOLIS

Three Roman nummi coins. Coin one: A copper-alloy Roman nummus of Constantine II dating to the period AD 330-331 (Reece Period 17). Obverse depicts: bust laureate, draped and cuirassed, right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C Reverse type: GLORIA EXERCITVS depicting two soldiers and two standards. Mint of Lyon, mintmark •[PLG] (RIC VII Lyon no. 244).. This coin measures 16.6 mm in diameter, 1.6 mm in thickness and weighs 1.6 grams. Coin two: A copper-alloy Roman nummus of Constantine II dating to the period AD 330-335 (Reece Period 17).
